headline: Prosecution seeks maximum punishment for Obaidul Quader and 6 others
summary: Chief Prosecutor Md Aminul Islam urged the International Crimes Tribunal-2 to impose the highest penalty for atrocities during the July Uprising.
details: The prosecution has sought the maximum punishment for Awami League General Secretary Obaidul Quader and six other leaders in a crimes against humanity case.
Chief Prosecutor Md Aminul Islam told the International Crimes Tribunal-2 that the prosecution had proved all four charges against the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
The charges include allegations that more than 1,400 protesters were killed and over 25,000 seriously injured in systematic attacks carried out with the accused's knowledge.
The other accused include former state minister Mohammad Ali Arafat, AL Joint General Secretary AFM Bahauddin Nasim, and leaders from Jubo League and Chhatra League.
The chief prosecutor stated that the absconding accused do not deserve any mercy and urged the tribunal to impose the highest punishment.
Following the conclusion of the prosecution's six-day-long arguments, defence lawyers have now begun presenting their submissions before the tribunal.
caption:
Over 1,400 killed and 25,000 injured. The prosecution now seeks the maximum penalty for Obaidul Quader and six other AL leaders.

The prosecution has sought the maximum punishment for Awami League General Secretary Obaidul Quader and six other leaders in a crimes against humanity case.

Chief Prosecutor Md Aminul Islam told the International Crimes Tribunal-2 that the prosecution had proved all four charges against the accused beyond reasonable doubt.

The charges include allegations that more than 1,400 protesters were killed and over 25,000 seriously injured in systematic attacks carried out with the accused's knowledge.

The other accused include former state minister Mohammad Ali Arafat, AL Joint General Secretary AFM Bahauddin Nasim, and leaders from Jubo League and Chhatra League.

The chief prosecutor stated that the absconding accused do not deserve any mercy and urged the tribunal to impose the highest punishment.

Following the conclusion of the prosecution's six-day-long arguments, defence lawyers have now begun presenting their submissions before the tribunal.

headline_marked: Bomb scare in Savar: [[Police recover suspected bomb]] from mosque field
headline: Bomb scare in Savar: Police recover suspected bomb from mosque field
summary: A pressure cooker-like object wrapped in tape was found in a plastic drum containing clothes and a Quran, sparking a security alert in Savar.
details: Police recovered a suspected bomb from the field of a mosque in Savar on Wednesday, August 12.
The object, which resembled a pressure cooker wrapped in black tape, was found inside a plastic drum along with clothes and a copy of the Holy Quran.
Locals discovered the drum in the field of the Laltik Ghora Mosque in the Sadaphur Goperbari area of Savar around 1:30 AM on Tuesday.
Police cordoned off the area and deployed the Bomb Disposal Unit to safely handle the object.
Authorities are currently investigating the purpose behind the placement of the drum and identifying the individuals responsible for it.
Police stated that the object will be confirmed as a bomb after further technical examinations.
caption:
A pressure cooker wrapped in black tape found in a mosque field sparks a major security alert in Savar.

Police recovered a suspected bomb from the field of a mosque in Savar on Wednesday, August 12.

The object, which resembled a pressure cooker wrapped in black tape, was found inside a plastic drum along with clothes and a copy of the Holy Quran.

Locals discovered the drum in the field of the Laltik Ghora Mosque in the Sadaphur Goperbari area of Savar around 1:30 AM on Tuesday.

Police cordoned off the area and deployed the Bomb Disposal Unit to safely handle the object.

Authorities are currently investigating the purpose behind the placement of the drum and identifying the individuals responsible for it.

Police stated that the object will be confirmed as a bomb after further technical examinations.

Source: Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo, Dhaka Tribune, The Daily Star
